subject: STOP statement
notes: kb/Work/PB411.md - LANDED, the twin of SR-14.9.18.3-7 at the shared screen. The CONDITIONAL is what makes the non-numeric form conforming - a rule that has to say 'if it is numeric' presupposes that it may not be - so 'STOP RUN WITH ERROR STATUS "007"' compiles and exits 7 while 'STATUS 1.5' draws COBOL1704 naming SR3. The screen is keyed on the BOUND SHAPE rather than the parse arm (kb/Work PB216), so a constant-name substituting 1.5 under 13.10.4 GR1 - which arrives on the dataReference arm - is screened by the same rule; that row is in the theory.
